fields.label: CalDAV Server URL (leave blank for iCloud)

healthcheck.title: Healthcheck
healthcheck.description: Verify connectivity and credentials for the CalDAV connector. Returns connector health status.

status.description: Connector health status: ok or error.

principal.discover.title: Discover Principal
principal.discover.description: Perform a PROPFIND on the CalDAV base URL to retrieve the current-user-principal href. This is the first step in CalDAV service discovery — call this before calendar_home.get.

principalHref.description: The current-user-principal href path returned by the server.

calendar_home.get.title: Get Calendar Home
calendar_home.get.description: Perform a PROPFIND on the principal href to retrieve the calendar-home-set href. Use the principalHref returned by principal.discover as input.

principalHref.description: The principal href path returned by principal.discover (e.g. /principals/user@example.com/).

calendarHomeHref.description: The calendar-home-set href path (directory containing all calendars for this user).

calendars.list.title: List Calendars
calendars.list.description: Perform a PROPFIND with Depth:1 on the calendar home to enumerate all calendars for the authenticated user. Returns display names, colors, supported component types, and CTags.

calendarHomeHref.description: The calendar-home-set href path returned by calendar_home.get (e.g. /1234567890/calendars/).

calendars.description: List of calendar objects with href, displayName, color, components (e.g. VEVENT), and ctag.

events.list.title: List Events
events.list.description: Perform a REPORT (calendar-query) with Depth:1 on a calendar href to retrieve VEVENT objects. Optionally filter by time range (start and end in ISO 8601 format). Returns event href, etag, uid, summary, start/end times, location, description, and raw iCalendar data.

calendarHref.description: The full path to the calendar collection (e.g. /1234567890/calendars/home/).

start.description: Optional. ISO 8601 start of time range filter (e.g. 2024-01-01T00:00:00Z).

end.description: Optional. ISO 8601 end of time range filter (e.g. 2024-12-31T23:59:59Z).

events.description: List of event objects with href, etag, uid, summary, start, end, location, description, calendarData.

events.get.title: Get Event
events.get.description: Perform a GET request on a specific event href to retrieve the full iCalendar (.ics) data. Returns parsed VEVENT fields plus raw iCalendar data and the current ETag.

eventHref.description: The full path to the event .ics resource (e.g. /1234567890/calendars/home/my-event-uid.ics).

events.create.title: Create Event
events.create.description: PUT a new VEVENT iCalendar resource to the CalDAV server with If-None-Match:* to ensure it is a new creation. Generates a new UID if not provided. Returns the event href, uid, and server-assigned ETag.

calendarHref.description: The path to the calendar collection where the event will be created.

start.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-06-15T10:00:00Z).

end.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-06-15T11:00:00Z).

uid.description: Optional. A unique identifier for the event. Generated as a UUID if omitted.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone name (e.g. America/New_York). Defaults to UTC.

attendees.description: Optional. List of attendee email addresses.

href.description: The path to the newly created event .ics resource.

events.update.title: Update Event
events.update.description: PUT updated iCalendar data to an existing event href using If-Match with the current ETag to prevent overwriting concurrent changes. Returns the updated href and new ETag.

eventHref.description: The full path to the existing event .ics resource.

etag.description: The current ETag of the event (from events.get or events.list). Used with If-Match to detect conflicts.

uid.description: The event UID (must match the existing event).

start.description: Event start time in ISO 8601 format.

end.description: Event end time in ISO 8601 format.

timezone.description: Optional. IANA timezone name. Defaults to UTC.

attendees.description: Optional. Updated list of attendee email addresses.

events.delete.title: Delete Event
events.delete.description: DELETE an event from the CalDAV server by its href. Optionally provide an ETag via If-Match to prevent accidental deletion of a modified event. Succeeds on 204, 200, or 404 (already deleted).

eventHref.description: The full path to the event .ics resource to delete.

etag.description: Optional. If provided, sent as If-Match header to prevent accidental deletion of a concurrently modified event.

alreadyGone.description: True if the event was already deleted (404 response).

freebusy.query.title: Query Free/Busy
freebusy.query.description: Perform a REPORT (free-busy-query) on a calendar or calendar home to retrieve free/busy time information for a given time range. Returns the raw VFREEBUSY iCalendar data.

href.description: The path to the calendar or calendar home to query for free/busy information.

start.description: Start of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-06-01T00:00:00Z).

end.description: End of the time range in ISO 8601 format (e.g. 2024-06-30T23:59:59Z).

freeBusyData.description: Raw iCalendar VFREEBUSY data returned by the server.

status.description: HTTP status code from the server.
